# Master list of GetBusbar repos to notify (via repository_dispatch, event_type=upstream-release)
# whenever busbar itself cuts a real release (release.yml, on a v* tag push).
#
# Each of these repos already has its own daily-poll self-heal workflow (the Homebrew-tap pattern —
# see GetBusbar/homebrew-busbar/.github/workflows/bump.yml, GetBusbar/helm-charts/.github/workflows/
# bump-chart.yml) that ALREADY accepts this dispatch as an optional instant trigger, layered on top
# of its own daily cron fallback. Polling never goes away — it's the safety net for a missed/failed
# dispatch; this list is what makes the common case same-minute instead of up-to-24h-later.
#
# To add a new downstream consumer to the release-notify fan-out: add its repo name here (one per
# line, `GetBusbar/<repo>` form) — no workflow-file edits needed elsewhere. The repo itself is
# responsible for having a workflow that accepts `repository_dispatch: types: [upstream-release]`;
# adding a name here without that workflow existing is a harmless no-op dispatch that repo ignores.
GetBusbar/homebrew-busbar
GetBusbar/helm-charts
GetBusbar/marketing
